During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] produced a '''laser cannon prototype''' for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[TIE series/Legends|TIE series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The prototype enhanced the TIE's firepower, but the weapon was considered to be too expensive for widespread use by many of the Empire's [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]].<ref name="CCG-Enhanced" />
